title: Local Dairy & Creamery
summary: Fresh cheese and milk often beat supermarket on flavor.
origins: Local food sourcing connects cooks to seasonality, community, and often better flavor per dollar when buying peak produce.
history: Combine with farmers market run when both are same-day.
teaching: Fresh cheese and milk often beat supermarket on flavor.
Farm stores may sell eggs and meat too.
Check sell-by dates — local often shorter shelf life, better taste.
